changelog:
Initial release of the clinical-trial-protocol skill.

- Generates a structured clinical trial protocol synopsis covering all elements expected by regulators and IRBs.
- Drafts objectives, design, eligibility, interventions, endpoints, statistical plan, safety, and ethics sections, all clearly labeled and internally consistent.
- Flags placeholders and assumptions for expert review; never invents prior data or effect sizes.
- Provides specific quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure output aligns with regulatory and ethical expectations.
- Intended as a drafting tool for qualified professionals, not as regulatory approval or final protocol sign-off.
